name: Keep Portland Quiet 2019
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. 

**Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!**
